title: Queue failure handling to a settled retry policy
carries: Retry policy: at most 5 attempts in total (the lease counts), backoff 30 * 2**(attempts - 1) seconds capped at 600, then state `dead` with dead_reason `nacked` or `expired`, never retried automatically.
why_not_in_repo: Session 1 implements only the happy path (lease and ack), which uses none of the policy, and the repository's state list stops at pending, running and done with no dead_reason field. The numbers and names were decided in session 1 and are arbitrary choices that cannot be derived from the code.

learn: Decision: retry policy for jobq. At most 5 attempts in total and the lease counts as an attempt. After a failed or expired attempt wait 30 * 2**(attempts - 1) seconds, capped at 600, before it can be leased again.
Decision: when a job has used all attempts it moves to state dead (the dashboard filters on dead) with dead_reason set to nacked or expired. Dead jobs are never retried automatically.
stub.recall_query: retry policy attempts backoff dead state dead_reason jobq
